scripts.build: style-dictionary build --config sd.config.mjs && npm run build:themes && npm run copy-packages && npm run copy-json
scripts.build:themes: tsc -p tsconfig.themes.json && cpy src/theme/*.json dist/js/theme && cpy src/theme/*.json dist/json/themes
scripts.copy-packages: cpy dist/js/**/* packages/js/dist/js && cpy dist/css/**/* packages/js/dist/css && cpy dist/compose/**/* packages/compose/dist/compose && cpy dist/ios/**/* packages/ios/dist/ios
